A relaxed table in the heart of Adajan

Little Fork Cafe is a welcoming vegetarian cafe in Palanpur, Adajan, Surat, where great food meets a relaxed atmosphere. Whether you’re catching up with friends, enjoying family time, working on your laptop or simply treating yourself, Little Fork is the perfect place to unwind.

100% Vegetarian FoodEvery dish, every drink
Cozy AtmosphereWarm light, green corners
Friendly ServiceFresh food, made to order
Affordable PricingMost meals ₹200–₹400 a person
